subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion — Pricing & Volume Step-ups (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>, Janelle Cho <janelle.cho@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Expansion — Pricing & Volume Step-ups (recap & next steps)

Hi Samir / Janelle — great to meet today. Quick recap of what we covered and proposed next steps: 

Summary of discussion:
- Renewal term: Acme Health is evaluating a 12–24 month renewal with an expanded scope to include two additional inference routes (clinical notes summarization + triage routing).
- Current monthly usage: ~120M tokens (in-production summarization + triage).
- Expected expansion: incremental 300–500M tokens/mo across new routes within 3–6 months, with seasonal spikes to ~900M in Q4.
- Key decision criteria: unit economics ($/1M tokens), predictable blended rates for billing, and the ability to add new model routes without lengthy procurement.

Pricing items we agreed to follow up on: 
1) Target unit economics — you asked for an illustrative target in $/1M tokens that would keep the renewal within budget. 
2) Volume step-up tiers — propose blended rates across combined token volumes (current + expansion).
3) Model routing add-ons — pricing for adding a new route/model (small setup + per-token increment).
4) Contract mechanics — timing for MLA updates and any procurement docs needed.

Attachments: I attached a draft MLA redline plus a spreadsheet with the step-up worked example (volume-stepup-models.xlsx).

Proposed next steps: 
- I will send a pricing worksheet with three blended-rate scenarios (conservative / mid / aggressive) by EOD Monday.
- Rishi will scope the blended-rate math and confirm any minimums for Dedicated pools if you want reserved capacity.
- Samir / Janelle — if you can confirm a target budget range (annual $) or target $/1M tokens, we can align the scenarios to that target.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

---
Attachments: ACME_MLA_draft_20270620.pdf (PDF, 12 pages), volume-stepup-models.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Janelle Cho <janelle.cho@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion — Pricing & Volume Step-ups (recap & next steps)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. A few clarifying notes from our side: 

- Budget context: Product org has penciled an annual budget delta of $180k–$300k for the expanded routes this year (we can flex depending on unit economics).
- Target unit economics: ideally under $1,200 / 1M tokens blended initially; if we can get to $1,000 / 1M at larger commitments, procurement will be happy.
- Volume assumptions: the 300–500M/mo is conservative; if the pilot performs well we could push to 700M/mo. Q4 spike to 900M is realistic.

Can you include a blended-rate table that shows total monthly cost at 120M, 420M, 820M, and 900M token points? Also want to see per-route breakout (summarization vs triage routing) if possible.

Samir
Head of Platform, Acme Health
samir@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>, Janelle Cho <janelle.cho@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion — Pricing & Volume Step-ups (recap & next steps)

Samir — thanks for the context. Attached is the pricing worksheet (volume-stepup-models.xlsx) with three scenarios mapped to your budget / unit economics ask. Key highlights (high level):

Conservative (no commitment change):
- Blended rate: $1,650 / 1M tokens
- Monthly cost @ 120M: $198
- Monthly cost @ 420M: $693
- Monthly cost @ 820M: $1,353

Mid (12-month committed step-up):
- Blended rate: $1,150 / 1M tokens
- Monthly cost @ 120M: $138
- Monthly cost @ 420M: $483
- Monthly cost @ 820M: $943

Aggressive (24-month committed + blended step tiers + reserved Dedicated buckets):
- Blended rate: $980 / 1M tokens
- Monthly cost @ 120M: $118
- Monthly cost @ 420M: $412
- Monthly cost @ 820M: $804

Notes on methodology (quick):
- Blended is modeled across a mix of routes and model sizes; we applied per-route weighting and a small per-request routing surcharge for triage (~3%).
- Reserved Dedicated pools change unit economics and cap tail latencies; we included a modest monthly dedicated capacity fee in the aggressive scenario.
- Adding a new model route: one-time onboarding fee $5,000 + $50 / 1M tokens incremental on top of the blended rate (this is configurable).

Rishi — can you confirm the math and whether we can tighten the aggressive blended rate to $950 / 1M if Acme signs a 24-month + minimum 6.5B token annual commit? Also confirm any minimum Dedicated pool sizing required.

Next steps: 
- Rishi to confirm numbers and Dedicated details.
- I’ll prepare a clean pricing summary to include in the MLA redline for procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion — Pricing & Volume Step-ups (recap & next steps)

Marissa / Samir — quick follow up after reviewing the worksheet. Confirmations and minor adjustments: 

- The blended math in the spreadsheet is correct; I tightened the aggressive scenario to $950 / 1M tokens conditional on a 24-month MLA + 6.5B token annual commit across routes. We can bake in a quarterly true-up.
- Dedicated sizing: to support steady-state 700–900M/mo with acceptable headroom we recommend a small Dedicated pool (2 x A100-equivalent reserved nodes) with autoscale burst. The dedicated monthly fee used in the aggressive scenario assumes this sizing.
- New route onboarding: keep $5k one-time; waive the onboarding fee if Acme commits to 24 months + the 6.5B annual minimum (one waived onboarding per contract).
- Billing mechanics: propose blended monthly invoice with a line-item showing committed vs overage tokens; overage billed at 10% premium over the blended rate.

I'll update the worksheet to reflect the tightened aggressive rate and add a per-route breakout. Marissa — send the updated MLA redline with these terms and I’ll add the technical appendix for Dedicated pool sizing.

Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
